_comment: Per-repo install hints layered over the live MiyooMini-Ports catalog. Keys are GitHub owner/repo (case-insensitive). Fields: asset (substring that must appear in the release asset name), all (install every asset that matches 'asset'), url (fixed download URL instead of a release), appDir (folder name under App/ when the archive has no folder), manual (can't be installed on-device; text explains why), note (extra tip shown after install), keep (glob list of user files never overwritten on update).

producdevity/stardew-valley-miyoo-mini-p.manual: Stardew needs a PC step: download the release, put your game depot in its gamefiles folder, run prepare.sh, then copy OnionOS-package/Roms to the SD card root.

scheeseman486/openrct2mini.manual: Released as a .7z archive, which Mixtape can't unpack. Extract it to the SD card root on a PC, then copy your RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 install into Roms/PORTS/Games/OpenRCT2mini/rct2/.

weimingtom/onscripter-jh-miyoo-mini-plus.manual: Source only: there is no prebuilt binary to install.

joyrider3774/miyoo_mini_games.note: Six games were added to Ports. If they don't show up, run '~Import ports' from the Ports list.

hotcereal/cloud-saves-miyoo-mini-plus.note: Cloud Saves also needs the rclone ARMv7 binary at the SD card root and a remote named 'cloud'. See the project's README.

xk9274/pico-8-wrapper-miyoo.note: Copy the Raspberry Pi pico8_dyn and pico8.dat from your PICO-8 purchase into App/pico/bin.

smonbon/miyooaudiobook.note: MiyooAudiobook needs a TTF font at App/MiyooAudiobook/assets/font.ttf.
